text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Nin nin♪ I clan girls～! Gaaather 'rouuuund～!

text_block_list.name: [I Clan] Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: We're heeeere～!

text_block_list.name: [I Clan] Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, we're delving right into practice,
are we! 
But I need to say… the two of you have such
cute costumes～!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Right!? So, Yaeno is our General and Creek is a Ninja? While the rest of us in jerseys are Infantry… right?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oh, remembered it well,
didn'st thou! Feeling a little 
more motivated now? I am glad to see it～!
Right then, as 'tis a complex game,
let us begin with a review!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
So, what is the Clan Clash…!? 'Tis a chaotic,
war-like 
team game in which clans try to conquer one
another's 
territory, doing battle with foam katanas!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In order to conquer such territory,
one must take down 
the clan's banner within it! Alternatively,
one can defeat 
the enemy's general!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: A clan will be considered Defeated when its territory is conquered. Let's aim to be the last clan standing, and Unify the Land under our rule～♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Mhm! In other words, to unify the land is to Win the match. A feat possible only by being the last clan standing within the allotted time!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Failing this, the game shall be considered a Draw between the remaining clans, no matter the scale of their territory!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
'Twill all take place in the hilly
countryside. 
We should thus expect a very physical
challenge～ I say we run, hide,
and await an opportunity!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Searching for enemy banners while
protecting 
your own is the foundation of every
strategy～♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Upon encountering an enemy,
'tis either fight or flee! 
The katanas contain a special device,
which shall react 
when hitting someone with sufficient
force.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It's just like electric scoring in fencing♪ A player who's been "cut down" is Eliminated. They'll have to leave at once～

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But anything other than eliminating their
general or taking down 
their banner won't defeat a clan.
So taking a blow for someone 
could be a good idea in some situations♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which,
watch out for friendly fire! 
The device in the weapons won't differentiate
friend from foe～

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
This folly is mine to bear… Whoa!
The general has arrived! 
Generals can take three hits,
and shan't go down by any less.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Regardless,
a general's elimination means their clan 
is as good as ours.
If an opportunity presents itself, 
we should seize the initiative～!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
When a clan is defeated,
all their remaining infantry 
will fall under the banner of the victor♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mhm! We should aim to leave alive as many
soldiers 
as we can when conquering a clan… Doing so
will 
benefit our own army and become key to
victory!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: By the way～ The ninja requires special attention! With their shuriken, ninjas can aim for the banner from afar♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, oookaaaay…? 
It all sounds a little complicated…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well,
you'll understand it quickly enough once
you do it. 
The main point is to protect our banner and
general while 
taking down our enemies', isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Then we just try to beat every clan like that.
We aren't ranked 
by how many clans we defeat,
probably because it would get 
boring if it became a stalemate by the second
half…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna know, do we have to place 
the banner in a specific spot?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A great question indeed! 
'Tis exactly what forms the crux of one's
strategy!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
So long as 'tis in our own territory and on
the ground, 
we are free to place it wherever we wish!
Therefore…

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The banner can be relocated!
Should enemies discover it, we 
can pick it up and escape!
One could just as well carry it at all 
times,
but naturally 'tis not ideal to have thine
hands occupied.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I see. The more we conquer,
the bigger our territory becomes, 
making it easier to hide our general and
banner…

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Exactly right!
With one's territory expansive, 
the search alone will leave enemies' hands
full.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wowiee～～～ everyone's so smart～! 
So this is what base warfare is like…

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, this is what it's like! Moving on,
let us finish warming up 
and acquaint ourselves with our katanas!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —— Haaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hyaan!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eeep, our general and No Reason are way too strong～～～! Can anyone even beat them one-on-one!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Na-ha-ha-haa, how splendid, Yaeno! 'Twould appear thou hast versed thyself in swordsmanship! I had not expected for thee to go toe to toe with me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: But while you're talking… I spot an opportunity! Heheeh～ you'd be out if this was an actual match～♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nraaah! Miracleee～!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm, my technique comes only from light exposure… I often swung kendo swords with Bamboo, so it might be because of that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm… I think I got a good a grasp on everyone's
strengths. 
Looks like rolling with our general in the
frontline is an option…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Tactics are quite important here,
huh. The banner's location, 
lineups and positioning… It's like a tower
defense game…

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hmm, mhmm… 'Twould seem Taishin shall be our strategist. Thou also boasts a long history with Hayahide, and art surely able to turn the tables on her!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I'm not thinking that grand… I just
don't want to lose. 
Not to Hayahide, not to anyone……

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But there doesn't seem to be anyone more suited for the job, so it would be a great help if you could do it. Right? So, madam Strategist… your orders please♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Uugh… Fine, then first drill this map into your heads. These are the starting positions……

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, we're starting there? Why are we all the way at the edge of the playing field? It does seem to provide a good view of the area, I guess～?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's the best we could have hoped for no
matter 
how you think about it.
We won't have to worry 
about being surrounded.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Unquestionably,
we needn't fear an attack from behind for
'tis out of bounds. Moreover,
'tis elevated. Luck is on our side…! 
Taking the high ground is a most ancient
and established tactic!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hm… 'tis also advantageous that the top two
clans 
are a good distance away.
'Twould be extremely difficult 
for either of them to attack up this hill.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Is that how it works～?
Hills do whittle at your stamina… 
And you carry momentum when descending…!

text_block_list.name: [I Clan] Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa～ So,
ain't that extremely advantageous? 
I'm starting to look forward to this!
Let's shoot for the win!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Heh… 'Twould seem our morale has risen greatly. Everyone, let us move forward with diligence!
